svg.metadata: {"id": "s100", "name": "四季大树", "cat": "自然与地理", "tags": ["科学", "四季", "语文", "自然观察"], "desc": "一棵大树分四季：树冠从左到右依次是春天粉花、夏天浓绿、秋天金红、冬天积雪枯枝，背景与地面同步四色渐变，花瓣、落叶、雪花飘落。", "stand": {"ground_y": 930, "x": [420, 1500]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sun_moon", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.15, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "hills", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "trunk", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "crown", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "winter_branches", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ground_details", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.8, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "falling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "birds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 1.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}], "palette": {"sp": "#FCE4EC", "su": "#D9F1FB", "au": "#FCE6C8", "wi": "#E4EAF6", "spg": "#A8DC8A", "sug": "#7CC466", "aug": "#E9B46A", "wig": "#FFFFFF", "wig2": "#DCE5F2", "blossom": "#F7A8C4", "blossom2": "#FFD6E4", "green": "#5FB56E", "green2": "#93D07E", "orange": "#F29A3E", "orange2": "#F7C55E", "red": "#E2654A", "snow": "#FFFFFF", "trunk": "#8C5A3A", "trunk2": "#6E4228", "sun": "#FFE7A0", "moon": "#FFF6D8", "flake": "#FFFFFF"}}
